_comment: Vietnam — the Import-Export Tariff (Biểu thuế xuất khẩu, nhập khẩu) as compiled at 5 April 2026. Vietnam publishes no machine-readable schedule of its own: the source is one 32 MB bilingual xlsx workbook, compiled by the Quang Ninh Customs Sub-Department and redistributed through a third-party law library, so there is no acquire adapter and no scheduled refresh. The workbook is fetched by hand into data/vn_tariff_source/.vn_download/ and scripts/hts_automation/parse_vn_tariff.py converts it, emitting the tariff CSV this spec consumes in BOTH languages (vn_tariff_<rev>.csv and .vi.csv, same codes and indents in the same order) plus the legal-notes corpus under data/hts_notes/vn_2026_0405/. Codes are 4/6/8 digits and the schedule never goes to 10, so max_depth is 8 — not 10 like Malaysia. Hierarchy is STATED by the source (the row's type cell encodes its depth) rather than inferred from printed dashes.
_comment_authority: The workbook is NOT the issuing instrument. Vietnam enacts its schedule by Government / Ministry of Finance Decree, and the Decree is the citable authority; each rate cell in the source names its own Decree and effective date (MFN_DECREE, MFN_EFFECTIVE in the CSV) so a published rate can be cited. Anything built from this file should say so.
_comment_ch98: Chapter 98 is Vietnam's own special-preference chapter — alternative duty lines for specified goods otherwise classified in chapters 1-97 — and it behaves differently from the AHTN schedule in three ways the loader has to know about: its rows carry no type marker (depth comes from the printed dash prefix), its UNIT column is empty because the source overloads it with the chapter 1-97 code each line maps to (moved to CORRESPONDING_CODES), and so its leaf flag comes from IS_LEAF rather than from a unit of quantity. See load_rows_vn() in build_hts_corpus.py.
_comment_lang: lang is en because the workbook is bilingual for chapters 1-97 (100% English there) and the English CSV is the default build. It is NOT bilingual for chapter 98: the source prints no English for any of its 531 lines, so a Vietnamese corpus built from the .vi.csv with --lang vi is the only one in which chapter 98 carries retrievable prose. The vi basket pattern and exclusion template are registered in build_hts_corpus.py for exactly that build.
_comment_revision: The revision id is the workbook's compilation date, 5 April 2026 -> 2026_0405, because the source has no edition or revision numbering of its own. The short link in circulation encodes the same date, so a later edition is expected to appear under a NEW link rather than at this URL. No resolver consumes revision_id_pattern today; it records the shape.
_comment_verify: No verify thresholds: those compare a revision against its predecessor and this is the first edition captured.

manual_revision._comment: The workbook is versioned by compilation DATE, not number, so rev_num is mmdd: it orders correctly and keeps two 2026 editions distinct under hts_revisions' (country, year, number) key.
